evidence: owner.lisp:1203 fnn-owner-feed-open failed-open path does (ignore-errors (fnn-close fd)): a physical close failure leaves no debt. owner.lisp:1244-1250 fnn-owner-feed-append-locked calls fnn-owner-feed-close unguarded before fnn-indeterminate, so a close failure replaces the indeterminate with the raw close error; its exit class then depends on *fnn-section-step* (not verified whether it classes as a fence).
fix: Failed-open close through the exact-debt path of the feed close; append-locked closes inside fnn-unwind-cleanups so the indeterminate stays primary.
title: Feed journal open/append swallow or replace close failures: failed-open path ignore-errors the close; append-locked closes unguarded before signalling indeterminate
